format_note: Product requirements and architecture entry point. The legacy v0 filename is retained as a stable entry path. Local design checks exist; product code, runtime boundary schemas and product gates remain pending implementation validation.

confirmed_requirements: Deliver an installed desktop program with a graphical interface.
Serve a repository owner who does not read code or routinely maintain plans.
Support understanding multiple repositories and their evolution.
Explain architecture, module boundaries, dependencies, progress and change opportunities.
Attach user ideas to relevant capabilities and modules.
Provide continuously refreshed views and navigable maps.
Support evolving plans instead of requiring a fixed implementation sequence.
Prioritize clean extension and AI implementation through explicit engineering contracts.
Discuss and establish the contract before implementing the product.
Optimize for low-cost correction, selective replacement and refactoring as ideas evolve.
Keep AI change context bounded and make affected ownership discoverable.
Support fast and deep AI capability roles without hard-coding provider identities.
proposed_decisions: Start with local, read-only analysis of one explicitly selected repository.
Deliver a trustworthy understanding loop before automatic code execution.
authority.architecture_selection: Delegated architecture design is recorded in contracts/decisions.v1.json; selected-for-validation choices can be revised through contracts/evolution.v1.json.
authority.rule: Do not treat unresolved product inputs as permission. The user delegated architectural selection; implementation and external actions remain outside this design turn. Later explicit user decisions supersede the design.

product_outcome.primary_question: What does this project do, what actually exists, what is uncertain, and what should I decide next?
limits: Static repository inspection cannot prove complete runtime behavior or production health.
Dependency edges alone do not establish harmful coupling.
AI recommendations must remain distinguishable from observations and owner decisions.

first_delivery_scope.outcome: For one explicitly selected repository, the owner can understand supported capabilities and dependencies, inspect their evidence and uncertainty, and retain a revisioned idea or adopted explanation across refresh and restart.
includes: Focused desktop map and list/detail alternative
Explicit partial, stale and unavailable states
success_checks: Against reviewed examples, report supported direct dependencies and avoid inventing dynamic targets or runtime status.
Explain likely capabilities in plain Chinese as interpretations, with inspectable supporting evidence and limitations; valid evidence IDs alone do not prove a statement is supported.
Capture an idea without requiring a source attachment; attached notes survive reanalysis or remain explicitly unresolved after an ambiguous split/merge.
Adopt an explanation with its exact output, permitted evidence and revisions retained together; a failed adoption leaves no partially adopted record.
Refresh and restart preserve owner records; old jobs cannot overwrite a newer view, and an unavailable AI provider leaves existing work usable.
first_delivery_scope.input_rule: Synthetic examples permit local design validation without selecting a real repository or product language. Confirm the dependent inputs before target-platform integration and final acceptance; AI calls additionally require explicit provider, data and budget policy.

domain_model.identity: Use stable repository-scoped IDs; preserve identity across supported renames and flag ambiguous matches.
domain_model.mapping: Capabilities and modules are many-to-many; neither directory names nor file counts define product scope.
domain_model.intent_note: Owner intent may exist before any source snapshot or evidence; preserve its own revision and author instead of fabricating source provenance.
domain_model.evidence: Include source locator, source revision or content hash, acquisition time, analyzer version and applicable scope.
domain_model.uncertainty: Show unknown, unsupported, partial, stale and failed explicitly. Never substitute a confident narrative for missing evidence.
domain_model.inferences: Include rationale, alternatives where material and qualitative uncertainty. Do not invent numerical confidence.
domain_model.history: Preserve decision and plan revision history; derived indexes may be rebuilt without losing user-authored ideas or decisions.

experience_invariants: Default to capability-level Chinese explanations; code and file references are optional evidence drill-downs.
Offer project overview, focused module map, ideas and planning, and change history as views of the same model.
Use hierarchy for ownership and typed directional edges for dependencies; a mind map alone is insufficient.
Group related modules reversibly without erasing their identities or dependency direction.
Keep current implementation and desired structure visually distinguishable; editing a desired map does not change source code.
Let the owner focus on a module and its relevant neighbors without displaying the entire repository graph.
Provide a keyboard-accessible list/detail equivalent to graphical navigation; do not encode meaning by color alone.
Display each view's snapshot, freshness and analysis coverage; preserve a visibly stale last-known view during refresh failures.
An idea may remain unassigned and must not become a committed requirement automatically.

analysis_and_progress.collection: Inspect selected source, manifests and Git metadata through bounded local adapters; do not execute repository code to scan it.
analysis_and_progress.analysis: Use deterministic extraction for supported structural facts and optional AI interpretation for business meaning and recommendations.
analysis_and_progress.coupling: Explain the specific relationship, observed evidence, likely impact and tradeoff. Label historical co-change as association, not proof of causation.
analysis_and_progress.completion: A work item is complete only relative to explicit acceptance criteria and linked verification results at a stated revision.
analysis_and_progress.planning: Version plans; record why priorities changed, affected dependencies and retained or invalidated acceptance evidence. Do not require a fixed linear sequence.
analysis_and_progress.production: Report release and runtime status only when corresponding CI, deployment or telemetry evidence is connected; otherwise show unknown.

architecture.rule: Module ownership, dependencies, data lifecycles and runtime boundaries are defined once in the referenced contract.

refresh_and_jobs.strategy: Incremental file and Git change detection with debouncing and reconciliation after missed events or restart.
refresh_and_jobs.consistency: Tag results with snapshot and content identity; do not merge stale analysis into current facts silently.
refresh_and_jobs.ai_jobs: Run interpretation asynchronously with cancellation, bounded retries, caching and configurable budget limits; do not trigger a full paid analysis on every edit.
refresh_and_jobs.failure: Isolate per-repository and per-adapter failures; preserve user data and expose actionable status.
refresh_and_jobs.performance: Measure structural refresh and semantic refresh separately; choose enforceable targets using the selected reference repository before implementation acceptance.

access_and_execution.default: Local-only, read-only access to explicitly selected repositories until the owner chooses broader authority.
access_and_execution.scan_boundary: Exclude credentials, secret files, ignored/generated content and paths escaping the selected root by default; allow explicit bounded inclusion.
access_and_execution.untrusted_content: Treat source comments, repository documents and tool output as data, never as authority to change permissions or dispatch actions.
access_and_execution.cloud: No transmission of repository content until provider, data scope and permission are established; show and enforce configured cost limits.
access_and_execution.commands: Running builds, tests, hooks or package installation is execution and requires an established execution policy; reading a repository does not authorize these actions.
access_and_execution.future_executor: Keep code modification behind a separate adapter with explicit scope, isolation, action history and verification; deployment authority is separate.
access_and_execution.workspace_policy: Before implementing shared credentials, metered resources, cross-project services or platform changes, run the applicable ai-cap check. Purely local implementation is not gated.
